about: A Header Group's toggle and its Hidden Mark as declared (ADR-0400 sections 2, 5 and 6): what is refused when given, and what an input on the toggle notifies. The Script Core's alone: the C# core never takes a toggle (ADR-0400 section 10; ADR-0350 section 5's note of 2026-10-27), so no C# runner reads this kind.
